authority: docs/plans/natural-history-recall.md revision 3; PC-01, PC-03, PC-05, PC-07, PC-09, PC-10

binding.context_recipe: B; no target-time compaction or newly generated summary
binding.review_policy: one shared H-capable natural reviewer binding for both arms
binding.deepseek_thinking: enabled; high reasoning effort from the pinned development deployment

corpus.selection: same workspace, subject, purpose and immutable definition root; succeeded run with user and assistant messages; most recent assistant source time then message ID; exclude current run
corpus.window: one complete user/assistant exchange; no clipping
corpus.overflow: omit whole exchange and record reason; no shortened lifecycle chain
corpus.coverage: every eligible exchange beyond the 128-row read cap is a corpus miss; source times order selection only, never global commit order

ranking.query: current user text plus the same admitted local B suffix; no future state or expected answer
ranking.tie_break: score descending, then assistant source time descending, then message ID
ranking.no_match_cutoff: none; return up to four complete windows and record misses
ranking.vectors: probe-local, content-and-recipe addressed; never use fact vector table or fact threshold
ranking.decision: choose the ranker on development evidence only, before held-out dialogue scoring

paired_schedule.base_packet_check: compare actual serialized packets after removing history and normalizing fixture identities
paired_schedule.generation_output_and_reviewer_limits: identical between arms; no baseline padding
paired_schedule.live_request_schedule: 3 ranking-development queries, 4 held-out ranking queries, 4 native-control turns, 11 target cases per arm, and 3 chronological follow-ups per arm; one planned run per cell and no success reroll; count actual generation and Qwen embedding dispatches observationally

evaluation.unacceptable_regression: added p95 > 15 seconds on the frozen paired targets, or any structural isolation/integrity violation, unauthorized write, stale-current claim, or repeated irrelevant callback
evaluation.scoring: blind arm labels; separate corpus, rank, sufficient evidence, admission, candidate, review, and delivered/committed delta; score safe incompleteness separately from adequate recall

cases.target: Ask naturally about an archived exchange under the same root but an older persona version
cases.delta: no new fact/revision/entity; no memory-generation advance

cases.target: Ask whether the original coffee report was always current after tea and a later coffee report
cases.delta: no new fact/revision/entity; no memory-generation advance

cases.delta: no new fact/revision/entity; no memory-generation advance
must_not: claim user originally said all day
describe fact repair as user retraction

cases.target: Ask about an earlier claim after the user explicitly said it was mistaken
cases.delta: no new fact/revision/entity; no memory-generation advance

give corrected value absent its dialogue

cases.target: Ask about an invalidated claim and an ended relationship
cases.delta: no new fact/revision/entity; no memory-generation advance

cases.target: Ask which earlier referent was meant without a fresh factual assertion
cases.delta: no new fact/revision/entity; no memory-generation advance

cases.delta: no new fact/revision/entity; no memory-generation advance

cases.target: Ask whether a past concern is still open

cases.target: Ambiguous antecedent and an unrelated goodnight follow-up

cases.delta: no new fact/revision/entity; no memory-generation advance
